instruction.text: Find and select the picnic basket to learn about another British holiday tradition.

feedback.end: From the beginning of the 1900s, camping has thrived in popularity as an affordable holiday choice for British people.

atoms.word: T h a m e s

feedback.finish: Camping began as an activity on the bank of the River Thames in the late 1800s. Many Londoners would choose to “camp out” during their boating trips along the river.

instruction.text: Charlotte is making a list of things to pack for her camping trip along the Thames.

atoms.a: What do you think is missing from her list?

feedback.end: Before camping became more common as a type of holiday, people used the tents made for the army or explorers.

instruction.text: Select the vehicle that people bring with them when camping.

feedback.end: The first caravan used by British campers was called an Eccles. It was sold for £90 and attached to the car with a leather strap.

atoms.b: After the 1938 Pay Act was passed, people also began to stay at ((++holiday business)) camps as an alternative to pitching up at campsites with their tents and caravans.
Now more commonly known as holiday parks, these camps offered a range of entertainment, such as outdoor swimming pools, ((++cycling studying)) and ballroom dancing.
Most people stayed in blocks of wooden chalets and ((++caravans planes)), which were also used in the second world war to house workers and soldiers.
